description: For each skill-reference connection, allow defining CLI tool assertions: a command to run (read-only tools with `--json` output), a JSONPath expression, a comparison operator (eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, exists, contains, matches, between), and an expected value. These represent the validation/search tools referenced in steer skills.

requirements.description: Define and implement schema for CLI tool assertions including command specification and JSONPath evaluations
requirements.title: CLI Tool Assertion Schema

title: CLI Tool Expectation Config
